# ponte_policy (Resource)

A Ponte policy (PPL YAML). Identified by its metadata.name; every change to the YAML saves a new version and archives the previous one. Agents bound to the policy follow the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ponte_policy" "refund_guard" {
  ppl              = file("${path.module}/policies/refund-guard.yaml")
  enforcement_mode = "observe" # enforce once you have watched it
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ppl` (String) The policy as PPL YAML (apiVersion ponte.io/v1, kind AgentPolicy). Changing it saves a new version.

### Optional

- `enforcement_mode` (String) enforce (the verdict binds decisions) or observe (evaluated and recorded, never binding).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) spec.description from the YAML.
- `id` (String) The policy name.
- `name` (String) metadata.name from the YAML.
- `policy_id` (String) The id of the active version. Changes on every edit.
- `version` (Number) The active version number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the policy's metadata.name. Set ppl in the configuration afterwards.
terraform import ponte_policy.refund_guard refund-guard
```
